```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
```

```{r data and helpers}
source("scripts/main-data.R")
source("scripts/helpers.R")
```

```{r s1: all 1304 significant genes}

# holy shit. never run clustering directly in ComplexHeatmap ever again.
# always cluster the matrix beforehand and plot as-is.
# much easier to save and pull matrices if ever needed.

# get clustered matrix for 936 upreg genes
up_hm = readRDS("data/heatmap_up_936.rds")
up_mat = up_hm@ht_list[["log2fold"]]@matrix
up_order = ComplexHeatmap::row_order(up_hm)
up_mat_ordered = up_mat[up_order, ]


# get clustered matrix for 368 downreg genes
dn_hm = readRDS("data/heatmap_dn_368.rds")
dn_mat = dn_hm@ht_list[["log2fold"]]@matrix
dn_order = ComplexHeatmap::row_order(dn_hm)
dn_mat_ordered = dn_mat[dn_order, ]



# pull tables

out = list()

for(l in c("up_mat_ordered", "dn_mat_ordered")){
  
  m = get(l)
  
  name = paste0(nrow(m), "_", l)
  
  # relabel columns
  df = m %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Gene) %>%
    mutate(
      name = case_when(
        
        str_detect(name, "WT naive") ~ 
          gsub("WT naive", "wt", name),
        
        str_detect(name, "sham naive") ~ 
          gsub("sham naive", "sham", name),
        
        str_detect(name, "TAK1KO naive") ~ 
          gsub("TAK1KO naive", "ko", name),
        
        str_detect(name, "TAK1KO lipid") ~ 
          gsub("TAK1KO lipid", "lipid", name),
        
        str_detect(name, "TAK1KO TAK1-smRNA") ~ 
          gsub("TAK1KO TAK1-smRNA", "nat", name),
        
        str_detect(name, "TAK1KO mTAK1-smRNA") ~ 
          gsub("TAK1KO mTAK1-smRNA", "D175A", name)
        
      )
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "name", values_from = "value")
  
  out[[name]] <- df
}

names(out) <- c(
  "936 IL1B-upreg genes (log2fold)",
  "368 IL1B-down genes (log2fold)"
)

write_xlsx(out, "table1-1304-sig-genes.xlsx")

cleanup_objects()
```

```{r s2: explore DEA results by venn group}
df = dea %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      group == "WT_naive" ~ "wt",
      group == "sham_naive" ~ "sham",
      group == "TAK1KO_naive" ~ "ko",
      group == "TAK1KO_lipid" ~ "lipid",
      group == "TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA" ~ "nat",
      group == "TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA" ~ "D175A"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(
    group, 
    levels = c("wt", "sham", "ko", "lipid", "nat", "D175A")
    )) %>%
  select(Gene, group, log2fold, FDR, sig)

out = list()

for(dir in c("up", "dn")){
  for(grp in c("sham", "ko", "lipid", "nat", "D175A")){
    
    pair = c("wt", grp)
    
    if (dir == "dn" & grp == "lipid"){next}
    
    name = paste0(dir, "reg - ", pair[1], " vs ", pair[2])
    
    # group assignments
    # which we have to regenerate because we never saved them...
    
    internal.logicalMatrix = df %>%
      filter(sig == dir, group %in% pair) %>%
      distinct(Gene, group, sig) %>%
      mutate(present = TRUE) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = group,
        values_from = present,
        values_fill = FALSE
      ) %>%
      select(Gene, wt, contains(grp)) %>%
      mutate(
        venn_group = case_when(
          .data[[pair[1]]] & !.data[[pair[2]]] ~ paste(pair[1], "only"),
          !.data[[pair[1]]] & .data[[pair[2]]] ~ paste(pair[2], "only"),
          .data[[pair[1]]] & .data[[pair[2]]] ~ paste(pair, collapse = " & ")
        )
      )
    
    internal.data = df %>%
      filter(group %in% c("wt", grp)) %>%
      select(-sig) %>%
      pivot_longer(c("log2fold", "FDR")) %>%
      unite("name", c("group", "name")) %>%
      pivot_wider(values_from = "value", names_from = "name")
    
    internal.df = internal.logicalMatrix %>%
      select(Gene, venn_group) %>%
      left_join(internal.data, by = "Gene")
    
    out[[name]] <- internal.df
    
  }
}

write_xlsx(out, "table2-explore-venns.xlsx")

cleanup_objects()
```



```{r s3: compare mean l2f values for 738 and 258 wt-reg genes}

wt_up_738 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

wt_dn_258 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

out = list()

for(l in c("wt_up_738", "wt_dn_258")){
  
  goi = get(l)
  
  df = tpm %>%
    filter(
      Gene %in% goi,
      treatment == "IL1B"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      group = case_when(
        group == "WT_naive" ~ "wt",
        group == "sham_naive" ~ "sham",
        group == "TAK1KO_naive" ~ "ko",
        group == "TAK1KO_lipid" ~ "lipid",
        group == "TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA" ~ "nat",
        group == "TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA" ~ "D175A"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(
      group, 
      levels = c("wt", "sham", "ko", "lipid", "nat", "D175A")
    )) %>%
    select(Gene, group, log2fold) %>%
    group_by(Gene, group) %>%
    summarize(log2fold = mean(log2fold), .groups = "keep") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "group", values_from = "log2fold")
  
  out[[l]] <- df
  
}

names(out) <- c("738 wt-upreg (avg log2fold)", "258 wt-dnreg (avg log2fold)")

write_xlsx(out, "table3-compare-wt-reg-genes.xlsx")
```
